_note: Tall full-body hero card art (Last Asylum style hero list and hero card), one per catalog hero id (shared/catalog/catalog.json heroes.list), matching hero.<id> and hero.<id>.bio in the loc files. Cut out by cards.py and copied to Assets/_Hadal/Resources/HeroArt/<id>.png. Seeds are fixed; change one to get a different design. The first style is longer than CLIP's 77 tokens (its background words are cut off); entries with their own shorter "style" were re-rolled for a full figure.
style: full body character standing, entire figure visible from head to boots, heroic confident pose, deep sea diver explorer, mobile strategy game hero card art, stylized semi-realistic painterly digital illustration, high detail face, cinematic rim light, cyan and amber accents, plain flat dark grey studio background
negative: text, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, cropped feet, cropped head, close-up, portrait crop, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, nsfw, multiple people, busy background, scenery
